title: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: English advanced listening test (CEFR B2). Transcription included. Watch a video about health and illnesses and answer the questions.

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch a video about a woman with chronic fatigue syndrome who has made a documentary about her condition. The documentary is called Unrest. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: When Jennifer Brea fell ill, she was ...
She decided to film herself and other people with chronic fatigue because...

choices.html: she wanted her family to see the effects of this disease on her.
has to spend most of the time in bed.
has intermittent periods when she feels fine.

questions.prompt: People who suffer from severe ME (chronic fatigue)...

choices.html: are in bed most of the time.

questions.prompt: Which thing does Jennifer NOT mention about the illness?

choices.html: there is a lack of good treatments.
